topic: UI Components, Design Patterns, and Design Systems
learningObjectives: Identify common UI components and their appropriate use cases.
Understand how reusable components create interface consistency.
Assemble a basic design system from reusable UI elements.

activities.title: UI Component Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the anatomy of common UI components.

content.concept: Buttons, inputs, cards, navigation, dialogs, and other components provide reusable interaction patterns.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Component Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each user need to the correct component.

content.concept: Choosing the right component reduces interaction complexity and creates familiar user experiences.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Component States Lab
activities.instruction: Explore how components respond to interaction states.

content.concept: Components commonly have states such as default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, and error.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
